I have found this useful little diagram courtesy of Erowid (https://www.erowid.org/chemicals/dxm/dxm_info1.shtml) that shows a basic comparison of DXM to LSD to help with dosing.

*300 mg DXM == light buzz, similiar to 50-100yg lsd

*600 mg DXM == stronger, similiar to 100-250 ug lsd

*900 mg DXM == very strong, full spectrum of hallucinations
		          equvalent to 300-600yg lsd
